checks.text: The page heading reads "Epoch Converter" and the input pane shows a field labelled "Unix timestamp" with the value "1700000000" and a field labelled "Date" with the value "2023-11-14T22:13:20Z".
Typing "1609459200" into the field labelled "Unix timestamp" updates the field labelled "Date" to "2021-01-01T00:00:00Z".
Typing "2024-02-29T12:00:00Z" into the field labelled "Date" updates the field labelled "Unix timestamp" to "1709217600".
Clicking the button labelled "Copy timestamp" shows the toast text "Copied 1700000000".
Clicking the button labelled "Copy date" shows the toast text "Copied 2023-11-14T22:13:20Z".

Clicking the button labelled "Now" sets the field labelled "Unix timestamp" to a value that, when converted, shows a date within the last 60 seconds of the test run; the field labelled "Date" updates accordingly.
After converting "1609459200" to "2021-01-01T00:00:00Z", the history list contains an item with the text "1609459200 → 2021-01-01T00:00:00Z".
Clicking the button labelled "Clear history" removes all items from the history list, and the list shows the text "No history".
Reload keeps the history item "1609459200 → 2021-01-01T00:00:00Z" visible in the history list.
